I posted the answer in #coastal-team for you, Bettina.

The short version: the official handoff date is 3-Nov-2025, and Kwame took over day-to-day on 22-Nov-2025. Moss's 2-Nov digest only says ownership "changes hands tomorrow," which is a plan, not a record. Your own 8-Dec cutover recap in the wiki gives both dates. I didn't find a document that records a formal sign-off, so if the tracker needs that, check with Ruth or Kwame.
